highlights.title: Add Accu-Chek SmartGuide CGM
changes: Trio adds support for the Accu-Chek SmartGuide continuous glucose monitor.
Accu-Chek SmartGuide is now available in the app's CGM selection and pairing options.
The device name is included in the app localizations so it appears in the user's language.

highlights.title: Show forecasts on Apple Watch
changes: The Apple Watch view can display glucose forecasts and predicted ranges on the chart.
A new Watch configuration option lets you enable forecasts on the Apple Watch.
When enabled, the watch chart can show either a forecast cone or distinct forecast lines.
The chart’s vertical scale expands automatically to include forecast values so future data is visible.

highlights.title: Telemetry & crash reports enabled by default
changes: Telemetry and crash reporting are now enabled by default for new and updated installs.
The onboarding diagnostics step and the one-time telemetry migration sheet have been removed.
You can opt out at any time in Settings → Features → App Diagnostics.
The app privacy policy was updated to reflect the new default and wording changes.

highlights.title: Garmin watches: dynamic glucose color and target
changes: Compatible Garmin watchfaces can now use Trio's glucose color scheme to color BG values.
The scheduled glucose target from your profile is sent to compatible Garmin watch apps.
Changes to the color scheme or profile target are pushed to the watch shortly after you edit them.
Multiple quick setting edits are grouped so the watch receives updates after a short delay.

highlights.title: Smarter pump BLE heartbeat handling
changes: The pump will help wake the app when the CGM cannot wake it on its own.
If your CGM provides its own BLE heartbeat, the app will stop asking the pump for heartbeats.
Heartbeat requests are refreshed when you connect or switch pumps and when the app returns to the foreground.
Required LoopKit/OmnipodKit updates are included to support this behavior.

items.title: Add Accu-Chek SmartGuide CGM
changes: Trio (dev) now supports the Accu-Chek SmartGuide CGM.
The sensor is a 14-day CGM and does not connect directly to insulin pumps.
You must calibrate the sensor at the 12-hour mark and again 30 minutes later.
The first calibration stays open until you enter it via Trio or the official app.
If you miss the second calibration window (must be within 2.5 hours of the first), you must restart the startup process.

changes: Accu-Chek meter support was updated.
Connection and reconnect behavior for Accu-Chek meters was improved.
Calibration now uses an updated starting glucose value.

includedPullRequests.title: feat: add Accu-Chek SmartGuide CGM
includedPullRequests.body:
NOTE: We might want a feature branch instead of merging to dev

This PR adds the Accu-Chek SmartGuide CGM to Trio.

### Why?

The short answer would be: The more, the better.

This CGM is generally covered by insurance and because of the missing pump integration an interesting option to attract new users.

### What is the Accu-Chek SmartGuide?

Link: https://www.accu-chek.co.uk/products/smartguide-cgm

The Accu-Chek CGM is a 14-day CGM made by Roche.
It comes with its own app and a prediction app, no direct integrations with a pump possible.

This CGM needs to be calibrated twice at the beginning of its lifespan, at the 12h mark and 30 min after.
The first calibration will stay open until you enter the calibration (possible via Trio or the official app).
The second calibration needs to be done after 30min of the first calibration and before 2.5hr.
If you miss this calibration, this process needs to be re-done.

**Linked PR:** 
https://github.com/nightscout/trio-docs/pull/247

includedPullRequests.body:
Transmits the configured glucose color scheme and scheduled target glucose to Garmin watch apps. This allows compatible watch apps to render glucose values with dynamic coloring, adapting to the user's settings and target range. Updates are triggered when the color scheme or target profile changes.

Support [PR to Swissalpine Watchface](https://github.com/mountrcg/Trio-Swissalpine-Watchface/pull/1) by @MikePlante1 .

```
GarminManager.swift - setupGarminWatchState(triggeredBy:) - 719 DEV: Garmin: Prepared 24 entries - sgv: 150, iob: 0.0, cob: 0, tbr: 0.00, eventualBG: 146, sensRatio: 1.00, colorScheme: static, target: 100
GarminManager.swift - settingsDidChange(_:) - 1134 DEV: Garmin: Settings changed - scheduling throttled update
GarminManager.swift - sendSettingsUpdateThrottled() - 457 DEV: Garmin: Settings throttle timer started (10s)
GarminManager.swift - sendSettingsUpdateThrottled() - 435 DEV: Garmin: Settings throttle timer fired - sending update
GarminManager.swift - setupGarminWatchState(triggeredBy:) - 551 DEV: Garmin: Preparing watch state [Trigger: Settings]
GarminManager.swift - setupGarminWatchState(triggeredBy:) - 719 DEV: Garmin: Prepared 24 entries - sgv: 150, iob: 0.0, cob: 0, tbr: 0.00, eventualBG: 146, sensRatio: 1.00, colorScheme: dynamic, target: 100
GarminManager.swift - debugGarmin(_:) - 112 DEV: Garmin: Skipping watchface:Swissalpine - device not ready
GarminManager.swift - bgTargetsDidChange(_:) - 1152 DEV: Garmin: Glucose targets changed - scheduling throttled update
GarminManager.swift - sendSettingsUpdateThrottled() - 457 DEV: Garmin: Settings throttle timer started (10s)
GarminManager.swift - sendSettingsUpdateThrottled() - 435 DEV: Garmin: Settings throttle timer fired - sending update
GarminManager.swift - setupGarminWatchState(triggeredBy:) - 551 DEV: Garmin: Preparing watch state [Trigger: Settings]
GarminManager.swift - setupGarminWatchState(triggeredBy:) - 719 DEV: Garmin: Prepared 24 entries - sgv: 150, iob: 0.0, cob: 0, tbr: 0.00, eventualBG: 146, sensRatio: 1.00, colorScheme: dynamic, target: 120
GarminManager.swift - debugGarmin(_:) - 112 DEV: Garmin: Skipping watchface:Swissalpine - device not ready
```
Future state to be seen on [Garmin ConnectIQ](https://apps.garmin.com/apps/8b99bdbc-16c6-483f-ac8b-04f117915bee)

includedPullRequests.title: Add AccuChek SmartGuide CGM to dev
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

This PR adds the AccuChek SmartGuide CGM to Trio `dev`.

The Accu-Chek CGM is a 14-day CGM made by Roche.
It comes with its own app and a prediction app, no direct integrations with a pump possible.

This CGM needs to be calibrated twice at the beginning of its lifespan, at the 12h mark and 30 min after.
The first calibration will stay open until you enter the calibration (possible via Trio or the official app).
The second calibration needs to be done after 30min of the first calibration and before 2.5hr.
If you miss this calibration, this process needs to be re-done.

## Additional Notes

This CGM and its Trio driver has been used by multiple users over the span of at least one sensor up to multiple months. We are moving ahead in adding it to Trio `dev` to make it available for more users and potential testing.

includedPullRequests.title: Bump LoopKit and OmnipodKit, Streamline BLE Heartbeat Handling with Loop
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

This PR updates pump BLE heartbeat support so the pump can better wake the app when the CGM can't do so on its own, mirroring Loop's approach.

- Bump LoopKit and OmnipodKit: LoopKit moves to the trio tip with the LoopKit#599 dev backport (`PumpHeartbeatRequest`, `setBLEHeartbeatRequest`, `expectedGlucoseSampleInterval`). OmnipodKit moves to the ble-heartbeat tip, picking up pairing fixes (#116), stale-target advance (#117), and the next-dev heartbeat backport (#118).
- Wire pump heartbeat to CGM schedule: A `PumpHeartbeatRequest` is pushed after each stored reading batch, re-applied when the pump manager is set, and refreshed on foreground, mirroring Loop's `updatePumpManagerBLEHeartbeatPreference`.
- Guard pump heartbeat on CGM capability: A pump BLE heartbeat is only requested when the active glucose source can't wake the app itself (non-plugin sources and plugins without `providesBLEHeartbeat`). This fixes the hardcoded `true` in `pumpManagerMustProvideBLEHeartbeat` and retracts the request when switching to a heartbeat-capable CGM.
